decisions: Evidence verification scripts under scripts/ and tests/ strictly validate relative file paths, reject Unix and Windows directory traversal (.. and ..\), reject Windows drive-absolute and UNC paths on every host OS, reject non-canonical path separators, use zero-dependency standard Node libraries, and never execute untrusted shell commands.
approvedAssumptions: No external credentials, tokens, network requests, or privileged capabilities are accessed by the evidence verifier or publication metadata.

evidence.source: threat-boundary analysis for final verifier and CI hardening
